title: RPG M VX Ace - Futuristic Tiles Resource Pack doesn't import

posts.author: Ste
posts.body:
Hi, I have the Futuristic Tiles Resource Pack for Rpg Maker VX Ace in my Steam library:
clicking on "Play now" it just opens Rpg Maker VX Ace and nothing happens.
Resources don't get imported and I don't know where to find them or how to import and use them.

posts.author: TRIDIUM
posts.body: You'll either have to find the place where steam installed RPG Maker and look in the DLC folder or click the "DLC" button in the resource manager.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
No resource will ever get automatically imported, because that would add it to your game and increase its download size.
because of that you will always manually import them to your project, although steam automatically downloads them into a local folder.
and as said above the quickest way to do that is by the resource manager of the editor, and then clicking on the DLC button.
Additional tip:
importing tilesheets does not create a tileset, you'll have to do that in your database after importing the tilesheets.
